node.title: Re^3: Ubuntu File Names with spaces and special characters
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
That explains a lot! My problem is that the squiggly (aka tilde) is NOT interpreted within SINGLE quotes.

The tilde ~ is in general not special to Perl. To get the home directory, there's e.g. [mod://File::HomeDir], or you could use [doc://glob] - but be aware that it'll treat any glob metacharacters as special, and there are [id://1206848|several caveats] when it comes to glob, which is why you might be interested in [mod://Path::ExpandTilde] instead.

What about the shell? Is it the login shell (Bash) or the shell the Perl source is invoked from (tcsh) or just Linux?

[id://1205217|That's not always clear], which is one of the reasons [id://1180578|I usually recommend] to avoid the shell altogether.
